faq.title: Your questions about buying glasses online, answered
faq.subtitle: Clear answers on prescription entry, virtual try-on sizing, lens options, and after-sales support.
faq.q1: What data do I need to provide for a prescription order?
faq.a1: You need a single-vision prescription from within the past year (OD/OS SPH, CYL, AXIS, and PD). Config Lab provides a sample guide and real-time validation.
faq.q2: Is the AR try-on the same as the real thing?
faq.a2: AR try-on and estimated PD are visual frame-sizing references only, not medical optometry. Actual dimensions and finish color follow the physical frame delivered.
faq.q3: How do I choose lens thickness?
faq.a3: We offer four base refractive indices: 1.56, 1.61, 1.67, and 1.74, plus optional AR and blue-light coatings. Config Lab recommends an index based on your SPH.
faq.q4: Can I return or remake if something isn't right?
faq.a4: Unopened frames qualify for 7-day return/exchange. Custom prescription lenses are non-refundable unless defective, and we handle wrong prescriptions, damage, or fit reviews via in-order after-sales tickets.
faq.a5: Yes. Standard single-vision orders support SPH ±20.00, CYL ±10.00, AXIS 0–180°, and PD 40–80mm. Complex prescriptions, children, or progressives require optician confirmation first.
faq.q6: How long until I receive my order?
faq.a6: Once payment and optician review are confirmed, orders dispatch within 7–10 business days (approx. 10 business days delivery; extensions apply if prescription info is supplemented).
